answers.core: This should be core because it makes the real-time debugging of applications a more enjoyable experience and it allows the developer to navigate through a less crowded Remote tab scene tree by explicitly and voluntarily marking nodes and their children as being removed from the tree.
answers.workaround: It could be an option that can be toggled on/off in the Remote tab scene tree. In that regard it would act like a filter, showing or hiding the flagged nodes.

title: Allow specific nodes to not show up in the Remote scene tree using a flag/node property
